results.original_proof_md:
F.1 分三部分。
(1) AND universal matching。作者要证 $\forall\varnothing\ne S\subseteq N,v_{and}(x_S)=\sum_{\varnothing\ne T\subseteq S}I_{and}(T\mid x)+v(x_\varnothing)$，并规定 $v_{and}(x_\varnothing)=v(x_\varnothing)$。按 Eq.(2)，$I_{and}(T\mid x)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}v_{and}(x_L)$。交换 $L\subseteq T\subseteq S$ 的求和顺序，固定L后先计算所有 $T\supseteq L$ 的线性组合，再对 $L\subseteq S$ 求和。作者分两类：(1) $L=S=T$ 的组合为 $(-1)^{|S|-|S|}v_{and}(x_L)=v_{and}(x_L)$；(2) $L\ne S$，令 $m=|T|-|L|$，$0\le m\le|S|-|L|$，对应T的个数为 $\binom{|S|-|L|}{m}$，所以
$$\sum_{T:L\subseteq T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}v_{and}(x_L)=v_{and}(x_L)\sum_{m=0}^{|S|-|L|}\binom{|S|-|L|}{m}(-1)^m=0.$$
原完整链（Eq.17）：
$$\begin{aligned}
\sum_{\varnothing\ne T\subseteq S}I_{and}(T\mid x)
&=\sum_{\varnothing\ne T\subseteq S}\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}v_{and}(x_L)\\
&=\sum_{L\subseteq S}\sum_{T:L\subseteq T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}v_{and}(x_L)-v_{and}(x_\varnothing)\\
&=v_{and}(x_S)+\sum_{L\subseteq S,L\ne S}v_{and}(x_L)\sum_{m=0}^{|S|-|L|}\binom{|S|-|L|}{m}(-1)^m-v_{and}(x_\varnothing)\\
&=v_{and}(x_S)-v_{and}(x_\varnothing)\\
&=v_{and}(x_S)-v(x_\varnothing).\quad\text{(17)}
\end{aligned}$$
故对每个非空S，$v_{and}(x_S)=\sum_{\varnothing\ne T\subseteq S}I_{and}(T\mid x)+v(x_\varnothing)$。
(2) OR universal matching。作者要证 $\forall S\subseteq N,v_{or}(x_S)=\sum_{T:T\cap S\ne\varnothing}I_{or}(S\mid x)$，并规定 $v_{or}(x_\varnothing)=0$。原此处和内仍写S。定义是 $I_{or}(T\mid x)=-\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}v_{or}(x_{N\setminus L})$。交换求和后固定L，计算 $\sum_{T:T\cap S\ne\varnothing,T\supseteq L}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}v_{or}(x_{N\setminus L})$，然后对L求和。作者分四类：
1. $L=N\setminus S$。此时 $T\ne L$；令 $|T^\prime|=|T|-|L|$，$1\le|T^\prime|\le|S|$。作者得到
$$\sum_{T:T\cap S\ne\varnothing,T\supseteq L}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}v_{or}(x_{N\setminus L})=v_{or}(x_S)\sum_{|T^\prime|=1}^{|S|}\binom{|S|}{|T^\prime|}(-1)^{|T^\prime|}=-v_{or}(x_S).$$
2. $L=N$，于是 $T=N$，组合为 $(-1)^{|N|-|N|}v_{or}(x_\varnothing)=v_{or}(x_\varnothing)$。
3. $L\cap S\ne\varnothing,L\ne N$。令 $T^\prime=\{i:i\in T,i\notin L,i\in N\setminus S\}$、$T^{\prime\prime}=\{i:i\in T,i\notin L,i\in S\}$，则 $|T|-|L|=|T^\prime|+|T^{\prime\prime}|$，$0\le|T^{\prime\prime}|\le|S|-|S\cap L|$。原组合写为
$$v_{or}(x_{N\setminus L})\sum_{T^\prime\subseteq N\setminus S\setminus L}\sum_{|T^{\prime\prime}|=0}^{|S|-|S\cap L|}\binom{|S|-|S\cap L|}{|T^{\prime\prime}|}(-1)^{|T^\prime|+|T^{\prime\prime}|}=0.$$
4. $L\cap S=\varnothing,L\ne N\setminus S$。令 $T^\prime=\{i:i\in T,i\notin L,i\in N\setminus S\}$、$T^{\prime\prime}=\{i:i\in T,i\in S\}$，原文取 $0\le|T^{\prime\prime}|\le|S|$，写
$$v_{or}(x_{N\setminus L})\sum_{T^\prime\subseteq N\setminus S\setminus L}\sum_{|T^{\prime\prime}|=0}^{|S|}\binom{|S|}{|T^{\prime\prime}|}(-1)^{|T^\prime|+|T^{\prime\prime}|}=0.$$
原完整链（Eq.18）：
$$\begin{aligned}
\sum_{T:T\cap S\ne\varnothing}I_{or}(T\mid x)
&=\sum_{T:T\cap S\ne\varnothing}\left[-\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}v_{or}(x_{N\setminus L})\right]\\
&=-\sum_{L\subseteq N}\sum_{T:T\cap S\ne\varnothing,T\supseteq L}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}v_{or}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&=-\left[\sum_{|T^\prime|=1}^{|S|}\binom{|S|}{|T^\prime|}(-1)^{|T^\prime|}\right]v_{or}(x_S)-v_{or}(x_\varnothing)\\
&\quad-\sum_{L\cap S\ne\varnothing,L\ne N}\left[\sum_{T^\prime\subseteq N\setminus S\setminus L}\left(\sum_{|T^{\prime\prime}|=0}^{|S|-|S\cap L|}\binom{|S|-|S\cap L|}{|T^{\prime\prime}|}(-1)^{|T^\prime|+|T^{\prime\prime}|}\right)\right]v_{or}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&\quad-\sum_{L\cap S=\varnothing,L\ne N\setminus S}\left[\sum_{T^\prime\subseteq N\setminus S\setminus L}\left(\sum_{|T^{\prime\prime}|=0}^{|S|}\binom{|S|}{|T^{\prime\prime}|}(-1)^{|T^\prime|+|T^{\prime\prime}|}\right)\right]v_{or}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&=-(-1)v_{or}(x_S)-v_{or}(x_\varnothing)-\sum_{L\cap S\ne\varnothing,L\ne N}\left[\sum_{T^\prime\subseteq N\setminus S\setminus L}0\right]v_{or}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&\quad-\sum_{L\cap S=\varnothing,L\ne N\setminus S}\left[\sum_{T^\prime\subseteq N\setminus S\setminus L}0\right]v_{or}(x_{N\setminus L})\\
&=v_{or}(x_S)-v_{or}(x_\varnothing)\\
&=v_{or}(x_S).\quad\text{(18)}
\end{aligned}$$
(3) 作者将AND与OR结论相加，$v(x_S)=v_{and}(x_S)+v_{or}(x_S)=v(x_\varnothing)+\sum_{\varnothing\ne T\subseteq S}I_{and}(T\mid x)+\sum_{T:T\cap S\ne\varnothing}I_{or}(T\mid x)$，得到AND-OR universal matching theorem。
results.overview: 固定论文分解 $a(S)=v_{and}(x_S),o(S)=v_{or}(x_S)$，$a+o=g$，$a(\varnothing)=b,o(\varnothing)=0$。Möbius 反演给 $a(S)=\sum_{T\subseteq S}I_a(T)=b+\sum_{\varnothing\ne T\subseteq S}I_a(T)$，空项只计一次。

definitions.body_md: Fix the finite universe $N$, input $x$, input baseline vector $r$ and real-valued model $v$. The mask $x_S$ retains $x_i$ in $S$ and uses $r_i$ elsewhere. Set $g(S)=v(x_S)$, output baseline $b=g(\varnothing)$ and centered game $g_0(S)=g(S)-b$. Source input $b_i$ maps to $r_i$, and scalar output baseline $b$ is not assumed zero.

Fix the same split $a(S)=g(S)/2+\gamma_S,o(S)=g(S)/2-\gamma_S$. Put $A(T)=I_a(T)$ and, for nonempty T, $O(T)=-I_h(T)$ with $h(L)=o(N\setminus L)$. The F.1 empty convention is $a(\varnothing)=b,o(\varnothing)=0$.

definitions.body_md: 固定有限总体 $N$、输入 $x$、输入基线向量 $r$ 与实值模型 $v$。掩码 $x_S$ 在 $S$ 内保留 $x_i$，其余取 $r_i$；原始游戏 $g(S)=v(x_S)$，输出基线 $b=g(\varnothing)$，中心化游戏 $g_0(S)=g(S)-b$。原输入 $b_i$ 对应 $r_i$，不将输出标量 $b$ 默认零。
$\tau$ 取样本平均相对输出幅度的3%；$\Omega_{and},\Omega_{or}$ 分别筛选两个分量。$Z$ 是 $1\le k\le n$ 阶数的平均强度，$Z_{theo}$ 对理论权重另定义；两个分母不预设为正。

results.original_statement_md:
原 Threshold and normalized strength 完整数学陈述（原符号）：
\[v(x)=\log\frac{p(y^{truth}\mid x)}{1-p(y^{truth}\mid x)},\quad\tau=0.03E_x|v(x)-v(x_\varnothing)|,\quad I_{real}^{(k)}=\frac{E_x[\sum_{type\in\{and,or\}}\sum_{S:|S|=k,|I_{type}(S\mid x)|\ge\tau}|I_{type}(S\mid x)|]}Z,\quad Z=E_{1\le k^\prime\le n}E_x[\sum_{type\in\{and,or\}}\sum_{S:|S|=k^\prime,|I_{type}(S\mid x)|\ge\tau}|I_{type}(S\mid x)|]\]\n理论指标（原第10页）：$I_{theo}^{(k)}=E_x[\sum_{S:|S|=k,|\hat w_S|\ge\tau_{theo}}|\hat w_S|]/Z_{theo}$，$Z_{theo}=E_{1\le k\prime\le n}E_x[\sum_{S:|S|=k\prime,|\hat w_S|\ge\tau_{theo}}|\hat w_S|]$，$v_{theo}(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq N}\hat w_S$，$\tau_{theo}=0.03|v_{theo}(x)-\hat w_\varnothing|$。

en.title: Salience threshold and normalized order strength

proof_steps.title: Salience threshold and normalized order strength
proof_steps.body_md: The complete theoretical metric is $I_{theo}^{(k)}=E_x[\sum_{S:|S|=k,|\hat w_S|\ge\tau_{theo}}|\hat w_S|]/Z_{theo}$, where $Z_{theo}=E_{1\le k\prime\le n}E_x[\sum_{S:|S|=k\prime,|\hat w_S|\ge\tau_{theo}}|\hat w_S|]$, $v_{theo}(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq N}\hat w_S$, and $\tau_{theo}=0.03|v_{theo}(x)-\hat w_\varnothing|$. assumptions: 原文只规定 DNN 与固定输入基线，没有解析性、Taylor 收敛区间或有限多项式前提。

definitions.body_md: 固定有限总体 $N$、输入 $x$、输入基线向量 $r$ 与实值模型 $v$。掩码 $x_S$ 在 $S$ 内保留 $x_i$，其余取 $r_i$；原始游戏 $g(S)=v(x_S)$，输出基线 $b=g(\varnothing)$，中心化游戏 $g_0(S)=g(S)-b$。原输入 $b_i$ 对应 $r_i$，不将输出标量 $b$ 默认零。
增量坐标 $z_i=x_i-r_i$；多重指标 $\pi_i\in\mathbb N$，支持 $\{i:\pi_i>0\}$，$Q_T$ 要求支持恰为 $T$。$D^\pi v(r)$ 是在输入基线向量处的经典混合导数，不是输出基线处导数。

results.original_statement_md:
原 Lemma 3; Eq.(19) 完整数学陈述（原符号）：
\[I(T\mid x)=\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}(x_i-b_i)^{\pi_i},\quad Q_T=\{[\pi_1,\ldots,\pi_n]^\top:\forall i\in T,\pi_i\in\mathbb N^+;\forall i\notin T,\pi_i=0\}\]
results.original_proof_md:
Lemma 3（原Eq.19）：
$$I(T\mid x)=\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}(x_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}.\quad\text{(19)}$$
其中 $Q_T=\{[\pi_1,\ldots,\pi_n]^\top:\forall i\in T,\pi_i\in\mathbb N^+;\forall i\notin T,\pi_i=0\}$。作者说明类似证明首先在[26]给出。
作者把Eq.19右端记为函数K，原文此句仍写“for S≠empty”：
$$K(T\mid x)\overset{def}=\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}(x_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}.\quad\text{(20)}$$
作者引用[13,23]，AND交互是满足下式的唯一指标：
$$\forall S\subseteq N,\quad v(x_S)=\sum_{\varnothing\ne T\subseteq S}I(T\mid x)+v(x_\varnothing).\quad\text{(21)}$$
因此只需证明K也满足该性质。在 $x_\varnothing=b=[b_1,\ldots,b_n]^\top$ 展开任意遮罩输出：
$$\forall S\subseteq N,\quad v(x_S)=\sum_{\pi_1=0}^{\infty}\cdots\sum_{\pi_n=0}^{\infty}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i=1}^n((x_S)_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}.\quad\text{(22)}$$
原b_i是遮罩输入xi的基线。遮罩规则给 $i\in S$ 时 $(x_S)_i=x_i$，$i\notin S$ 时 $(x_S)_i=b_i$；被遮罩正次因子为0，零次因子规定为1。故只保留 $P_S=\{[\pi_1,\ldots,\pi_n]^\top:\forall i\in S,\pi_i\in\mathbb N;\forall i\notin S,\pi_i=0\}$ 中的项：
$$\forall S\subseteq N,\quad v(x_S)=\sum_{\pi\in P_S}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in S}(x_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}.\quad\text{(23)}$$
$P_S$ 分为不交集合 $\bigcup_{T\subseteq S}Q_T$，因此原Eq.24只有如下两行：
$$\begin{aligned}\forall S\subseteq N,\quad v(x_S)&=\sum_{T\subseteq S}\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}(x_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}\\&=\sum_{\varnothing\ne T\subseteq S}K(T\mid x)+v(x_\varnothing).\quad\text{(24)}\end{aligned}$$
原注说明第二步按Eq.20；当 $T=\varnothing$ 时Q_T仅含全零指标，对应 $v(x_\varnothing)$。所以K满足Eq.21，作者得到 $I(T\mid x)=K(T\mid x)=\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}(x_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}$。

lean.scope:
The source imposes no analyticity restriction on the DNN or input and uses a global Taylor equality. Take the one-variable ReLU network $v(t)=\max(t-1/2,0)$, baseline $r=0$, and $x=1$. The network vanishes near the baseline, so all derivatives at $0$ vanish. Its Taylor right side is zero whereas $I(\{1\})=v(1)-v(0)=1/2$. This refutes the unrestricted statement; adding analyticity would change it.

A separate valid finite-polynomial result remains: a monomial of support $A$ obeys $m_A(z^S)=\mathbf1_{A\subseteq S}m_A(z)$ because masked positive-degree coordinates annihilate it. Grouping by support reconstructs every mask, and uniqueness identifies those coefficients with actual dividends. This does not prove the unrestricted Taylor claim.

results.original_proof_md:
给定具体样本 $\hat x$，作者考虑Eq.6和7的函数：
$$f(x)=\sum_{T\subseteq N}w_TJ_T(x),\quad\text{(25)}$$
其中 $w_T=I(T\mid x=\hat x)$，$J_T(x)=\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}(x_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}/w_T$。作者要证每个S都有 $f(\hat x_S)=v(\hat x_S)$。完整原链及原注编号：
$$\begin{aligned}
f(\hat x_S)&=\sum_{T\subseteq N}w_TJ_T(\hat x_S)\quad\text{(26)}\\
&=\sum_{T\subseteq N}\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}((\hat x_S)_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}\quad\text{(27)}\\
&=\sum_{T\subseteq S}\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}((\hat x_S)_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}\quad\text{(28)}\\
&=\sum_{T\subseteq S}\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}(\hat x_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}\quad\text{(30)}\\
&=\sum_{\varnothing\ne T\subseteq S}I(T\mid x=\hat x)+v(x_\varnothing)\quad\text{(32)}\\
&=v(\hat x_S).\quad\text{(33)}
\end{aligned}$$
原Eq.27旁注是w_T约去。原编号29是文字注：若 $T\nsubseteq S$，存在 $j\in T\setminus S$ 使 $(\hat x_S)_j-b_j=0$，全项为0。原编号31也是文字注：当 $T\subseteq S$ 时每个 $i\in T$ 满足 $(\hat x_S)_i=\hat x_i$。Eq.32原注使用刚证明的Lemma3逆向，Eq.33使用universal matching逆向。
原Remark：f给universal matching Eq.3的连续实现；w_T是未遮罩样本的交互，J_T连续扩展AND指标，故称触发函数、其值称触发强度。

definitions.body_md: 固定有限总体 $N$、输入 $x$、输入基线向量 $r$ 与实值模型 $v$。掩码 $x_S$ 在 $S$ 内保留 $x_i$，其余取 $r_i$；原始游戏 $g(S)=v(x_S)$，输出基线 $b=g(\varnothing)$，中心化游戏 $g_0(S)=g(S)-b$。原输入 $b_i$ 对应 $r_i$，不将输出标量 $b$ 默认零。

原 Lemma 1; Eq.(37)–(40) 完整数学陈述（原符号）：
\[\forall S\subseteq N,\ \widetilde v(x_S)=v(x_S)+\Delta v_S,\quad\Delta v_S\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2);\quad\forall\varnothing\ne T\subseteq N,\ \widetilde I(T\mid x)=I(T\mid x)+\Delta I_T,\quad E\Delta I_T=0,\quad\operatorname{Var}\Delta I_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2;\quad\widetilde J_T(x)=J_T(x)+\epsilon_T,\quad\epsilon_T=\Delta I_T/w_T,\quad E\epsilon_T=0,\quad\operatorname{Var}\epsilon_T\propto2^{|T|}\sigma^2\]
results.original_proof_md:
作者按Eq.2从全部遮罩分数提取 $\widetilde I(T\mid x)=\sum_{S\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|S|}\widetilde v(x_S)$。因原假设 $\forall S\subseteq N,\widetilde v(x_S)=v(x_S)+\Delta v_S,\Delta v_S\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)$，展开为：
$$\begin{aligned}
\widetilde I(T\mid x)&=\sum_{S\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|S|}\widetilde v(x_S)\quad\text{(34)}\\
&=\sum_{S\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|S|}(v(x_S)+\Delta v_S)\quad\text{(35)}\\
&=\sum_{S\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|S|}v(x_S)+\sum_{S\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|S|}\Delta v_S\quad\text{(36)}\\
&=I(T\mid x)+\Delta I_T.\quad\text{(37)}
\end{aligned}$$
原I为无噪声非随机项，$\Delta I_T=\sum_{S\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|S|}\Delta v_S$ 为噪声。作者此处称每个Gaussian噪声独立同分布，于是 $E\Delta I_T=\sum_{S\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|S|}E\Delta v_S=0$，并计算
$$\begin{aligned}\operatorname{Var}\Delta I_T&=\operatorname{Var}\left(\sum_{S\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|S|}\Delta v_S\right)\quad\text{(38)}\\&=\operatorname{Var}\Delta v_{S_1}+\operatorname{Var}\Delta v_{S_2}+\cdots+\operatorname{Var}\Delta v_{S_{2^{|T|}}}\quad\text{(39)}\\&=2^{|T|}\sigma^2.\quad\text{(40)}\end{aligned}$$
作者的理由为T有 $2^{|T|}$ 个子集。又按Eq.19交互解析式，作者称 $\widetilde I(T\mid x)$ 与 $\widetilde J_T(x)$ 的比为w_T；写 $\widetilde J_T=J_T+\epsilon_T$ 后噪声为 $\epsilon_T=\Delta I_T/w_T$，得到 $E\epsilon_T=0,\operatorname{Var}\epsilon_T\propto2^{|T|}\sigma^2$。

lean.scope:
Linearity gives $\Delta I_T=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}\Delta v_L$ without independence. Finite expectation linearity gives zero mean from the marginal laws.

The main statement specifies only Gaussian marginals $\Delta v_L\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)$.  For one variable use the same $Z\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)$ for both masks, $\Delta v_\varnothing=\Delta v_{\{1\}}=Z$. All stated marginal conditions hold, but $\Delta I_{\{1\}}=Z-Z=0$ has variance zero rather than $2\sigma^2$ when $\sigma>0$. F.3 adds iid noise to eliminate covariance.

Lemma 1: noisy dividend variance:
\[\forall S\subseteq N,\ \widetilde v(x_S)=v(x_S)+\Delta v_S,\quad\Delta v_S\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2);\quad\forall\varnothing\ne T\subseteq N,\ \widetilde I(T\mid x)=I(T\mid x)+\Delta I_T,\quad E\Delta I_T=0,\quad\operatorname{Var}\Delta I_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2;\quad\widetilde J_T(x)=J_T(x)+\epsilon_T,\quad\epsilon_T=\Delta I_T/w_T,\quad E\epsilon_T=0,\quad\operatorname{Var}\epsilon_T\propto2^{|T|}\sigma^2\]

\[\hat w=\arg\min_w\widetilde L(w)=(J^\top J+2^n\operatorname{diag}(c))^{-1}J^\top y=(J^\top J+2^n\operatorname{diag}(c))^{-1}J^\top Jw^*=\hat Mw^*,\quad J=[\mathbf J(x_{S_1}),\ldots,\mathbf J(x_{S_{2^n}})]^\top,\quad y=[y(x_{S_1}),\ldots,y(x_{S_{2^n}})]^\top,\quad c=\operatorname{vec}\{\operatorname{Var}\epsilon_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2:T\subseteq N\}\]
results.original_proof_md:
作者把 $2^n$ 行触发向量排成 $J$，噪声排成 $E=[\epsilon^{(1)},\ldots,\epsilon^{(2^n)}]^\top$，标签排成 $y$。原式链：
$$\begin{aligned}\hat w&=\arg\min_w\widetilde L(w)\quad\text{(41)}\\\widetilde L(w)&=E_\epsilon E_{S\subseteq N}(y_S-w^\top(J(x_S)+\epsilon))^2\quad\text{(42)}\\&=E_E\left[2^{-n}\|y-(J+E)w\|_2^2\right]\quad\text{(43)}\\&=2^{-n}E_E[(y-(J+E)w)^\top(y-(J+E)w)]\quad\text{(44)}\\&=2^{-n}\{y^\top y-2y^\top E_E[J+E]w+w^\top E_E[(J+E)^\top(J+E)]w\}.\quad\text{(45)}\end{aligned}$$
作者求导并令其为零：
$$\partial\widetilde L/\partial w=-2E_E[(J+E)^\top]y+2E_E[(J+E)^\top(J+E)]w=0.\quad\text{(46)}$$
因此
$$\begin{aligned}E_E[(J+E)^\top(J+E)]w&=E_E[(J+E)^\top]y\quad\text{(47)}\\(J^\top J+E_E[E^\top J]+J^\top E_E[E]+E_E[E^\top E])w&=J^\top y\quad\text{(48)}\\(J^\top J+E_E[E^\top E])w&=J^\top y.\quad\text{(49)}\end{aligned}$$
作者说当 $m=2^n$ 很大时样本协方差 $m^{-1}E^\top E$ 收敛到真实 $\operatorname{Cov}(E)$，据此写 $E_E[E^\top E]=E_E[2^n\operatorname{Cov}(E)]=2^n\operatorname{diag}(c)$；不同交互噪声独立使协方差对角，$c_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2$。得到
$$(J^\top J+2^n\operatorname{diag}(c))w=J^\top y.\quad\text{(50)}$$
作者分四步论证可逆：(1) $u^\top J^\top Ju=\|Ju\|_2^2\ge0$；(2) 因 $J^\top J$ 对角元均正，原文写 $\prod_i\lambda_i=\prod_i(J^\top J)_{ii}>0$，所以全部特征值正；(3) $2^n\operatorname{diag}(c)$ 每项正，正定矩阵之和正定；(4) 正定矩阵无零特征值所以可逆。于是
$$\hat w=(J^\top J+2^n\operatorname{diag}(c))^{-1}J^\top y.\quad\text{(51)}$$
最后 $y(x_S)=v(x_\varnothing)+\sum_{\varnothing\ne T\subseteq S}w_T^*$，由 Lemma 2 与 $w_\varnothing^*=v(x_\varnothing)$ 得 $y(x_S)=J(x_S)^\top w^*$。作者随后原文写 $y=J^\top w^*$，并结尾写 $\hat w=(J^\top J+2^n\operatorname{diag}(c))^{-1}J^\top Jw^*=\hat Mw^*$。

en.title: Theorem 3: unique noisy least-squares optimum
en.overview: Under Assumption 1, the trigger noise is independent, centered, and has $c_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2$. Expand each masked squared residual: cross expectations vanish and $E[(\sum_Tw_T\epsilon_T)^2]=\sum_Tc_Tw_T^2$. Thus $2^n\widetilde L(w)=\|y-Jw\|^2+2^n\sum_Tc_Tw_T^2$ exactly; no large-sample covariance limit is needed.
assumptions: Source Assumption 1: independent centered trigger noise with $c_T=\operatorname{Var}\epsilon_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2$. Its ordinary finite-second-moment meaning is encoded as MemLp 2 in Lean.
Average uniformly over all $2^n$ masks. Use Lemma 2 on its defined binary-design domain, $J_{ST}=\mathbf1_{T\subseteq S}$ and $y=Jw^*$, including the empty coordinate.

definitions.body_md: Fix the finite universe $N$, input $x$, input baseline vector $r$ and real-valued model $v$. The mask $x_S$ retains $x_i$ in $S$ and uses $r_i$ elsewhere. Set $g(S)=v(x_S)$, output baseline $b=g(\varnothing)$ and centered game $g_0(S)=g(S)-b$. Source input $b_i$ maps to $r_i$, and scalar output baseline $b$ is not assumed zero.

Let $\mathcal A=2^N$ and $m=|\mathcal A|=2^n$. Vectors $y,w,w^*\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal A}$ include every coalition, with $y_S=g^*(S)$. Matrix $J\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal A\times\mathcal A}$ has mask rows S, concept columns T, and entries $J_{ST}=\mathbf1_{T\subseteq S}$. Trigger noise $\epsilon=(\epsilon_T)_{T\in\mathcal A}$ lives on a probability space and has variance vector $c_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2$. Put $B=J^\top J$, $D=m\operatorname{diag}(c)$, $A=B+D$ and $\hat M=A^{-1}B$. Row $\hat m_T$ has Euclidean norm equal to the square root of its squared-entry sum. The source loss is $\widetilde L(w)=m^{-1}\sum_{S\in\mathcal A}E[(y_S-(Jw)_S-w^\top\epsilon)^2]$.

proof_steps.title: Compute the expected loss exactly
proof_steps.body_md: Under Assumption 1, the trigger noise is independent, centered, and has $c_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2$. Expand each masked squared residual: cross expectations vanish and $E[(\sum_Tw_T\epsilon_T)^2]=\sum_Tc_Tw_T^2$. Thus $2^n\widetilde L(w)=\|y-Jw\|^2+2^n\sum_Tc_Tw_T^2$ exactly; no large-sample covariance limit is needed.

proof_steps.title: Inversion, positivity and unique global minimality
proof_steps.body_md: For the source binary design $J_{ST}=\mathbf1_{T\subseteq S}$, $Jw$ is the subset-sum operator and Möbius inversion proves injectivity. Hence $u^\top J^\top Ju=\|Ju\|^2>0$ for nonzero $u$. The diagonal penalty $2^n\operatorname{diag}(c)$ is positive semidefinite even at $\sigma=0$, so $A=J^\top J+2^n\operatorname{diag}(c)$ is positive definite and invertible. For $u=A^{-1}J^\top y$, completing the square gives $2^n(\widetilde L(w)-\widetilde L(u))=(w-u)^\top A(w-u)>0$ when $w\ne u$, proving unique global minimality.

proof_steps.body_md: Rowwise labels satisfy $y_S=\sum_{T\subseteq S}w_T^*$, so $y=Jw^*$; F.4 prints the erroneous transpose $J^\top w^*$. Substitution proves the original Theorem 3. The domain issue in Eq.(7) remains separate, without assigning unrequested values to zero weights.

results.original_proof_md:
作者按Eq.7给具体样本 $\hat x$ 的触发：
$$J_T(x)=\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}(x_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}/w_T.\quad\text{(52)}$$
其中 $w_T=I(T\mid x=\hat x)$，$Q_T=\{[\pi_1,\ldots,\pi_n]^\top:\forall i\in T,\pi_i\in\mathbb N^+;\forall i\notin T,\pi_i=0\}$。作者要证遮罩样本满足 $J_T(\hat x_S)=\mathbf1(T\subseteq S)$，分两类。
Case 1：$T\nsubseteq S$，存在 $j\in T\setminus S$。遮罩使 $(\hat x_S)_j-b_j=0$，而 $j\in T$ 使 $\pi_j>0$，所以
$$\forall\pi\in Q_T,\quad\prod_{i\in T}((\hat x_S)_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}=0.\quad\text{(53)}$$
每项为0，所以 $J_T(\hat x_S)=0$。
Case 2：$T\subseteq S$，每个 $i\in T$ 也在S内，遮罩规则给 $(\hat x_S)_i=\hat x_i$。按F.2的Eq.19，
$$w_T=I(T\mid x=\hat x)=\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}(\hat x_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}.\quad\text{(54)}$$
因此原完整链是
$$\begin{aligned}
J_T(\hat x_S)&=\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}((\hat x_S)_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}/w_T\quad\text{(55)}\\
&=\frac{\displaystyle\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}((\hat x_S)_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}}{\displaystyle\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}(\hat x_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}}\quad\text{(56)}\\
&=\frac{\displaystyle\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}(\hat x_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}}{\displaystyle\sum_{\pi\in Q_T}\frac1{\prod_{i=1}^n\pi_i!}\left.\frac{\partial^{\pi_1+\cdots+\pi_n}v}{\partial x_1^{\pi_1}\cdots\partial x_n^{\pi_n}}\right|_{x=x_\varnothing}\prod_{i\in T}(\hat x_i-b_i)^{\pi_i}}\quad\text{(57)}\\
&=1.\quad\text{(59)}
\end{aligned}$$
Eq.56原注按Eq.54；编号58是文字注：已证每个 $i\in T$ 有 $(\hat x_S)_i=\hat x_i$。合并两情况得到二值触发。作者据此称无论如何改变DNN或输入，$J=[\mathbf J(x_{S_1}),\ldots,\mathbf J(x_{S_{2^n}})]^\top\in\{0,1\}^{2^n\times2^n}$总是固定二值矩阵。

results.title: 同阶行向量等范数
assumptions: 原 Theorem 3 的二值设计与按阶数方差；$T,T\prime\subseteq N$ 且 $|T|=|T\prime|$，$\sigma^2\ge0$ 包括零。

definitions.body_md: 固定有限总体 $N$、输入 $x$、输入基线向量 $r$ 与实值模型 $v$。掩码 $x_S$ 在 $S$ 内保留 $x_i$，其余取 $r_i$；原始游戏 $g(S)=v(x_S)$，输出基线 $b=g(\varnothing)$，中心化游戏 $g_0(S)=g(S)-b$。原输入 $b_i$ 对应 $r_i$，不将输出标量 $b$ 默认零。

令 $\mathcal A=2^N$，$m=|\mathcal A|=2^n$。$y,w,w^*\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal A}$；$y_S=g^*(S)$。矩阵 $J\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal A\times\mathcal A}$ 的行S是遮罩、列T是概念，$J_{ST}=\mathbf1_{T\subseteq S}$。触发噪声 $\epsilon=(\epsilon_T)_{T\in\mathcal A}$ 定义在概率空间上，方差向量 $c_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2$。$B=J^\top J$，$D=m\operatorname{diag}(c)$，$A=B+D$，$\hat M=A^{-1}B$；$\hat m_T$ 是 $\hat M$ 的第T行，欧氏范数为该行平方和的平方根。原损失是 $\widetilde L(w)=m^{-1}\sum_{S\in\mathcal A}E[(y_S-(Jw)_S-w^\top\epsilon)^2]$。

results.original_statement_md:
原 Theorem 4; Eq.(60)–(64) 完整数学陈述（原符号）：
\[\hat w_T=\hat m_T^\top w^*,\quad\hat M=[\hat m_{T_1},\ldots,\hat m_{T_{2^n}}]^\top;\quad\forall T,T^\prime\subseteq N,\ |T|=|T^\prime|\Longrightarrow\|\hat m_T\|_2=\|\hat m_{T^\prime}\|_2\]
results.original_proof_md:
作者要证明同阶 $T,T'$ 的行向量互为排列。定义由变量排列诱导的对称变换 $\mathcal T(A)=P_k\cdots P_1AP_1\cdots P_k$，每个 $P_i$ 为排列矩阵。令 $B=J^\top J,D=2^n\operatorname{diag}(c)$，则
$$(J^\top J+2^n\operatorname{diag}(c))\hat M=J^\top J\quad\text{(60)},\qquad (B+D)\hat M=B.\quad\text{(61)}$$
Step 1：变量集 $N=\{1,\ldots,n\}$ 的排列作用于幂集的全部行列，例 $N=\{1,2,3\}$、交换 $1,3$，$[\varnothing,\{1\},\{2\},\{3\},\{1,2\},\{1,3\},\{2,3\},N]$ 变成 $[\varnothing,\{3\},\{2\},\{1\},\{3,2\},\{3,1\},\{2,1\},N]$。包含关系保持，故 $\mathcal T(B)=B$；$D_{TT}=2^{|T|+n}\sigma^2$ 只依赖阶数，所以 $\mathcal T(B+D)=B+D$。
Step 2：作者写 $\mathcal T(B+D)\hat M=\mathcal T(B)$（Eq.(62)），即
$$P_k\cdots P_1(B+D)P_1\cdots P_k\hat M=P_k\cdots P_1BP_1\cdots P_k.\quad\text{(63)}$$
若 $\hat M$ 解此方程，则 $\mathcal T(\hat M)=P_k\cdots P_1\hat MP_1\cdots P_k$ 也解，因为 $P_i^2=I$。$B+D$ 可逆使解唯一，所以 $\mathcal T(\hat M)=\hat M$（Eq.(64)）。同阶集合可构造变量排列使 $T$ 映到 $T'$，故两行互为排列，Euclidean 范数相等。
results.overview: 在二值设计的既定回归模型中取变量排列 $p$，它诱导幂集排列 $P$。因包含关系不变，$PJP^{-1}=J$，故 $PBP^{-1}=B$，$B=J^\top J$。噪声对角 $D_{TT}=2^{n+|T|}\sigma^2$ 只依赖阶数，故 $PDP^{-1}=D$。

proof_steps.body_md: 在二值设计的既定回归模型中取变量排列 $p$，它诱导幂集排列 $P$。因包含关系不变，$PJP^{-1}=J$，故 $PBP^{-1}=B$，$B=J^\top J$。噪声对角 $D_{TT}=2^{n+|T|}\sigma^2$ 只依赖阶数，故 $PDP^{-1}=D$。

proof_steps.title: 同阶集合排列与行范数
proof_steps.body_md: $A=B+D$ 已证可逆；$A\hat M=B$。将整个等式共轭给 $A(P\hat MP^{-1})=B$，解唯一推出 $P\hat MP^{-1}=\hat M$。若 $|T|=|T'|$，在有限总体上把 $T$ 到 $T'$ 的双射与补集双射合起来得到变量排列。上述矩阵等式把第 $T$ 行映为第 $T'$ 行并同时排列列，故平方和与二范数保持。该证明在 $\sigma=0$ 同样成立。

en.title: Theorem 4: equal norms at equal orders
en.overview: In the fixed binary regression model, a variable permutation $p$ induces a powerset permutation $P$. Inclusion is preserved, hence $PJP^{-1}=J$ and $PBP^{-1}=B$ for $B=J^\top J$. The noise diagonal $D_{TT}=2^{n+|T|}\sigma^2$ depends only on order, so $PDP^{-1}=D$.
assumptions: Theorem 3 binary design and order-dependent variances; $T,T\prime\subseteq N$ with equal cardinality and $\sigma^2\ge0$, including zero.

definitions.body_md: Fix the finite universe $N$, input $x$, input baseline vector $r$ and real-valued model $v$. The mask $x_S$ retains $x_i$ in $S$ and uses $r_i$ elsewhere. Set $g(S)=v(x_S)$, output baseline $b=g(\varnothing)$ and centered game $g_0(S)=g(S)-b$. Source input $b_i$ maps to $r_i$, and scalar output baseline $b$ is not assumed zero.

Let $\mathcal A=2^N$ and $m=|\mathcal A|=2^n$. Vectors $y,w,w^*\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal A}$ include every coalition, with $y_S=g^*(S)$. Matrix $J\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal A\times\mathcal A}$ has mask rows S, concept columns T, and entries $J_{ST}=\mathbf1_{T\subseteq S}$. Trigger noise $\epsilon=(\epsilon_T)_{T\in\mathcal A}$ lives on a probability space and has variance vector $c_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2$. Put $B=J^\top J$, $D=m\operatorname{diag}(c)$, $A=B+D$ and $\hat M=A^{-1}B$. Row $\hat m_T$ has Euclidean norm equal to the square root of its squared-entry sum. The source loss is $\widetilde L(w)=m^{-1}\sum_{S\in\mathcal A}E[(y_S-(Jw)_S-w^\top\epsilon)^2]$.

proof_steps.title: Conjugation invariance of the full matrix
proof_steps.body_md: In the fixed binary regression model, a variable permutation $p$ induces a powerset permutation $P$. Inclusion is preserved, hence $PJP^{-1}=J$ and $PBP^{-1}=B$ for $B=J^\top J$. The noise diagonal $D_{TT}=2^{n+|T|}\sigma^2$ depends only on order, so $PDP^{-1}=D$.

proof_steps.title: Permute equal-order coalitions and row norms
proof_steps.body_md: Invertibility of $A=B+D$ has already been proved. Conjugating the full equation $A\hat M=B$ yields $A(P\hat MP^{-1})=B$, and uniqueness gives $P\hat MP^{-1}=\hat M$. If $|T|=|T'|$, combine bijections between these finite sets and their complements to obtain a variable permutation. The matrix identity carries one row to the other while permuting columns, preserving squared sums and Euclidean norms. This includes $\sigma=0$.

en.title: Theorem 5: exact recovery at zero noise
en.overview: The shared proof establishes injectivity of the finite binary design, hence invertibility of its square matrix and positive definiteness of $B=J^\top J$. At $\sigma=0$ the diagonal penalty vanishes, giving $B^{-1}Bw^*=w^*$. This also recovers the empty weight $w_\varnothing^*=b$ without a zero output baseline. Completing the square makes the optimum unique.
assumptions: The Theorem 3 regression setting with $\sigma=0$, without an assumption $b=0$.

definitions.body_md: Fix the finite universe $N$, input $x$, input baseline vector $r$ and real-valued model $v$. The mask $x_S$ retains $x_i$ in $S$ and uses $r_i$ elsewhere. Set $g(S)=v(x_S)$, output baseline $b=g(\varnothing)$ and centered game $g_0(S)=g(S)-b$. Source input $b_i$ maps to $r_i$, and scalar output baseline $b$ is not assumed zero.

Let $\mathcal A=2^N$ and $m=|\mathcal A|=2^n$. Vectors $y,w,w^*\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal A}$ include every coalition, with $y_S=g^*(S)$. Matrix $J\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal A\times\mathcal A}$ has mask rows S, concept columns T, and entries $J_{ST}=\mathbf1_{T\subseteq S}$. Trigger noise $\epsilon=(\epsilon_T)_{T\in\mathcal A}$ lives on a probability space and has variance vector $c_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2$. Put $B=J^\top J$, $D=m\operatorname{diag}(c)$, $A=B+D$ and $\hat M=A^{-1}B$. Row $\hat m_T$ has Euclidean norm equal to the square root of its squared-entry sum. The source loss is $\widetilde L(w)=m^{-1}\sum_{S\in\mathcal A}E[(y_S-(Jw)_S-w^\top\epsilon)^2]$.

Section 3.3.3 interprets the first phase as approaching the large-noise optimum and the second as movement of that optimum as noise declines. The proven regression formula is static; it specifies neither an SGD trajectory, a noise schedule nor a relation between epoch and $\sigma$. It therefore does not directly prove dynamics for every DNN.

For a fixed positive-definite quadratic, gradient descent with $0<\eta<1/\lambda_{max}(A)$ obeys $h_{t+1}=(I-2\eta A)h_t$ and converges. That update and step-size premise are absent from the source DNN claim, so this is a separate conditional model.

definitions.body_md: 固定有限总体 $N$、输入 $x$、输入基线向量 $r$ 与实值模型 $v$。掩码 $x_S$ 在 $S$ 内保留 $x_i$，其余取 $r_i$；原始游戏 $g(S)=v(x_S)$，输出基线 $b=g(\varnothing)$，中心化游戏 $g_0(S)=g(S)-b$。原输入 $b_i$ 对应 $r_i$，不将输出标量 $b$ 默认零。

results.original_proof_md:
Appendix E：OR可以在互换出现/遮罩状态后视为一类AND。给 $x\in\mathbb R^n$，$b\in\mathbb R^n$ 为输入遮罩基线，原坐标定义为
$$ (x_T)_i=\begin{cases}x_i&i\in T,\\b_i&i\in N\setminus T.\end{cases}\quad\text{(12)}$$
按该定义，AND是 $I_{and}(S\mid x)=\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}v_{and}(x_T)$，OR是 $I_{or}(S\mid x)=-\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}v_{or}(x_{N\setminus T})$。作者为简化分析假设 $v_{and}(\cdot)=v_{or}(\cdot)=0.5v(\cdot)$。互换出现与遮罩状态的样本定义为
$$ (\widetilde x_T)_i=\begin{cases}x_i&i\in N\setminus T,\\b_i&i\in T.\end{cases}\quad\text{(13)}$$
然后原链直接用裸v：
$$\begin{aligned}I_{or}(S\mid x)&=-\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}v(x_{N\setminus T})\quad\text{(14)}\\&=-\sum_{T\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}v(\widetilde x_T)\quad\text{(15)}\\&=-I_{and}(S\mid\widetilde x).\quad\text{(16)}\end{aligned}$$
作者最后称[27]的AND稀疏证明可扩展到OR，因此后续只分析AND即可。

proof_steps.body_md: Apply the Möbius transform to the source reconstruction identity at every mask. Inversion gives $I_{\operatorname{reconstruct}d}(S)=d(S)$, while the premise identifies the reconstructed game with $g$. Thus $d(S)=I_g(S)$. proof_steps.title: Basis games isolate linear transform coefficients
proof_steps.body_md: To isolate the transform coefficients claimed by the author, take real coefficients a(S,U), independent of the game g and supported on U⊆S, whose transformed values reconstruct every mask for every game. The first step identifies each transformed value with I_g(S). Fix U and choose the basis game $g_U(L)=\mathbf1_{L=U}$. Only L=U survives in either finite sum: the proposed transform gives a(S,U), and the Möbius transform gives $(-1)^{|S|-|U|}$. Thus every coefficient of the linear operator is unique. This basis argument is unavailable for a single fixed game and does not establish uniqueness of a joint AND/OR split parameter gamma.

shared_proofs.title: 共享证明：有限多项式支持与二值掩码
assumptions: 有限坐标总体；有限单项式索引集P，每项k的支持A_k与自然次数d_{k,i}满足i∈A_k时严格正；每项实系数c_k，不要求支持互异。

definitions.body_md: $P$ 为有限项索引集，$A_k,d_{k,i},c_k$ 为各项支持、次数、系数；$K_A=\sum_{k\in P:A_k=A}c_km_{A_k}(z)$。$z_i=x_i-r_i$ 为增量，$z_i^S=z_i$（i∈S）、0（其余）；$m_A(z)=\prod_{i\in A}z_i^{d_i}$。

shared_proofs.overview: 定义单项式 $m_A(z)=\prod_{i\in A}z_i^{d_i}$，其中每个 $d_i>0$；掩码增量坐标为 $z_i\mathbf1_{i\in S}$。若 $A\subseteq S$，每个因子不变；若不是，取 $i\in A\setminus S$，正次零因子使全积零。这给精确支持律。
shared_proofs.proof_scope: 实际Lean证明单项式遮罩律、任意有限项索引多项式的遮罩和、按支持分组重构及真实Möbius交互等于支持贡献；同支持不同次数可同时存在。另验证非零参考贡献的二值归一化。无限Taylor收敛与任意DNN不是本共享命题。

proof_steps.title: 检查正次单项式的遮罩
proof_steps.body_md: 定义单项式 $m_A(z)=\prod_{i\in A}z_i^{d_i}$，其中每个 $d_i>0$；掩码增量坐标为 $z_i\mathbf1_{i\in S}$。若 $A\subseteq S$，每个因子不变；若不是，取 $i\in A\setminus S$，正次零因子使全积零。这给精确支持律。

proof_steps.title: 分组支持并归一化非零贡献
proof_steps.body_md: 对有限个单项式逐项应用支持律，将同支持的贡献累加为 $K_A$。全部掩码输出为 $\sum_{A\subseteq S}K_A$，有限 Möbius 唯一性给 $K_A=I_g(A)$，包括空支持常数。若 $u=K_A(x)\ne0$，则 $K_A(x_S)/u=\mathbf1_{A\subseteq S}$。不声称无限 Taylor 在任意网络收敛。

en.title: Shared proof: finite-polynomial support and binary masks
en.overview: Define $m_A(z)=\prod_{i\in A}z_i^{d_i}$ with every $d_i>0$ and masked increment coordinates $z_i\mathbf1_{i\in S}$. If $A\subseteq S$, every factor is retained. Otherwise choose $i\in A\setminus S$; its positive-degree zero factor annihilates the product. This proves the exact support identity.
assumptions: A finite coordinate universe and finite monomial index set P. Each support A_k has strictly positive natural degrees on its coordinates and a real coefficient c_k. Distinct terms may share a support.

definitions.body_md: Let P index finitely many terms, with support A_k, degrees d_{k,i} and coefficients c_k. Put $K_A=\sum_{k\in P:A_k=A}c_km_{A_k}(z)$. The increment is $z_i=x_i-r_i$, with $z_i^S=z_i$ in S and zero elsewhere. Define $m_A(z)=\prod_{i\in A}z_i^{d_i}$.

en.proof_scope: Lean proves monomial masking, masked sums for arbitrary finite term indices, reconstruction grouped by support, and equality of actual Möbius dividends to support contributions. Equal supports with different degrees are allowed. Nonzero reference normalization is also verified. Infinite Taylor convergence and arbitrary DNNs are outside this shared claim.

proof_steps.title: Mask positive-degree monomials
proof_steps.body_md: Define $m_A(z)=\prod_{i\in A}z_i^{d_i}$ with every $d_i>0$ and masked increment coordinates $z_i\mathbf1_{i\in S}$. If $A\subseteq S$, every factor is retained. Otherwise choose $i\in A\setminus S$; its positive-degree zero factor annihilates the product. This proves the exact support identity.

proof_steps.title: Group supports and normalize nonzero contributions
proof_steps.body_md: Apply this identity to every term in a finite polynomial and group equal supports into $K_A$. All mask outputs equal $\sum_{A\subseteq S}K_A$, so finite Möbius uniqueness identifies $K_A=I_g(A)$, including the constant empty support. If $u=K_A(x)\ne0$, normalization gives $K_A(x_S)/u=\mathbf1_{A\subseteq S}$. No convergence of an infinite Taylor series for an arbitrary network is claimed.

assumptions: 概率测度、可测独立的有限随机量族；每个因子具有有限二阶矩。残差子结论另取中心化噪声和指定方差。

definitions.body_md: $X_i:\Omega\to\mathbb R$、$\epsilon_i:\Omega\to\mathbb R$；$E$是真实概率积分，$\operatorname{Var}X=E(X-EX)^2$。$r,w_i$ 为固定实数，$q_i$为噪声方差；Gaussian子结论通过map-law规定分布。

shared_proofs.overview: 在概率测度下，独立可测随机量 $X_i$ 各有有限二阶矩，独立乘积可积且有有限二阶矩。对 $X_i$ 及 $X_i^2$ 分别使用乘积积分分解，得 $E\prod_iX_i=\prod_iEX_i$，$E(\prod_iX_i)^2=\prod_iEX_i^2$。用 $EX_i^2=(EX_i)^2+\operatorname{Var}X_i$，相减得乘积方差 $\prod_i[(EX_i)^2+\operatorname{Var}X_i]-\prod_i(EX_i)^2$。
shared_proofs.proof_scope: 实际积分产品矩、乘积L2、中心化残差期望与Gaussian矩前提的推导全部编译；本篇具体适配与其他论文的缩放分别提供。

proof_steps.title: 分解独立产品的一阶与二阶积分
proof_steps.body_md: 在概率测度下，独立可测随机量 $X_i$ 各有有限二阶矩，独立乘积可积且有有限二阶矩。对 $X_i$ 及 $X_i^2$ 分别使用乘积积分分解，得 $E\prod_iX_i=\prod_iEX_i$，$E(\prod_iX_i)^2=\prod_iEX_i^2$。用 $EX_i^2=(EX_i)^2+\operatorname{Var}X_i$，相减得乘积方差 $\prod_i[(EX_i)^2+\operatorname{Var}X_i]-\prod_i(EX_i)^2$。

proof_steps.title: 计算中心化加权残差
proof_steps.body_md: 若 $\epsilon_i$ 独立、中心化、方差为$q_i$，有限加权和 $Z=\sum_iw_i\epsilon_i$ 均值零、方差 $\sum_iw_i^2q_i$，故 $E(r+Z)^2=r^2+\sum_iw_i^2q_i$。这是真实积分，不是形式矩占位。

proof_steps.title: 由 Gaussian 映射律得到矩

en.title: Shared proof: independent-product moments and squared residuals
en.overview: Under a probability measure, measurable independent $X_i$ with finite second moments have an integrable product with finite second moment. Factor the integrals for $X_i$ and $X_i^2$: $E\prod_iX_i=\prod_iEX_i$ and $E(\prod_iX_i)^2=\prod_iEX_i^2$. Substitute $EX_i^2=(EX_i)^2+\operatorname{Var}X_i$ and subtract the mean square to obtain the product-variance formula $\prod_i[(EX_i)^2+\operatorname{Var}X_i]-\prod_i(EX_i)^2$.
assumptions: A probability measure and a finite measurable independent family with finite second moments. The residual subresult additionally uses centered noises with specified variances.

definitions.body_md: $X_i,\epsilon_i:\Omega\to\mathbb R$; E denotes an actual probability integral and variance is $E(X-EX)^2$. Residual r and weights w_i are fixed reals, while q_i are noise variances; the Gaussian subresult specifies laws through map-laws.

proof_steps.body_md: For independent centered $\epsilon_i$ with variances $q_i$, the finite weighted sum $Z=\sum_iw_i\epsilon_i$ has mean zero and variance $\sum_iw_i^2q_i$. Therefore $E(r+Z)^2=r^2+\sum_iw_i^2q_i$. These are actual integrals, rather than formal moment placeholders.

Independent shifted factors $1+\epsilon_i$ have mean one and variance $q$, hence their product has mean one and variance $(1+q)^s-1$. This paper applies the proof to the independent submodel of Lemma 1 and to rowwise residuals in Theorem 3. assumptions: 有限完整幂集设计J；非负对角惩罚d，y为任意有限实标签向量。

definitions.body_md: 令 $\mathcal A=2^N$，$m=|\mathcal A|=2^n$。$y,w,w^*\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal A}$；$y_S=g^*(S)$。矩阵 $J\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal A\times\mathcal A}$ 的行S是遮罩、列T是概念，$J_{ST}=\mathbf1_{T\subseteq S}$。触发噪声 $\epsilon=(\epsilon_T)_{T\in\mathcal A}$ 定义在概率空间上，方差向量 $c_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2$。$B=J^\top J$，$D=m\operatorname{diag}(c)$，$A=B+D$，$\hat M=A^{-1}B$；$\hat m_T$ 是 $\hat M$ 的第T行，欧氏范数为该行平方和的平方根。原损失是 $\widetilde L(w)=m^{-1}\sum_{S\in\mathcal A}E[(y_S-(Jw)_S-w^\top\epsilon)^2]$。

shared_proofs.overview: 在论文 Assumption 1 的独立零均值、方差 $c_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2$ 模型中，对每个遮罩展开平方。交叉期望为零且 $E[(\sum_Tw_T\epsilon_T)^2]=\sum_Tc_Tw_T^2$，因此精确有 $2^n\widetilde L(w)=\|y-Jw\|^2+2^n\sum_Tc_Tw_T^2$。不需要“大样本协方差收敛”。

proof_steps.title: 证明 Gram 正定并完成平方
proof_steps.body_md: 采用论文二值设计 $J_{ST}=\mathbf1_{T\subseteq S}$，$Jw$ 是 subset sum，Möbius 反演给 $J$ 单射。于是非零 $u$ 满足 $u^\top J^\top Ju=\|Ju\|^2>0$；$2^n\operatorname{diag}(c)$ 半正定，包括 $\sigma=0$。$A=J^\top J+2^n\operatorname{diag}(c)$ 正定可逆。设 $u=A^{-1}J^\top y$，精确完成平方得到 $2^n(\widetilde L(w)-\widetilde L(u))=(w-u)^\top A(w-u)>0$（$w\ne u$），故 $u$ 是唯一全局最优解。

en.title: Shared proof: invertible Möbius design and global regression optimum
en.overview: Under Assumption 1, the trigger noise is independent, centered, and has $c_T=2^{|T|}\sigma^2$. Expand each masked squared residual: cross expectations vanish and $E[(\sum_Tw_T\epsilon_T)^2]=\sum_Tc_Tw_T^2$. Thus $2^n\widetilde L(w)=\|y-Jw\|^2+2^n\sum_Tc_Tw_T^2$ exactly; no large-sample covariance limit is needed.

definitions.body_md: Let $\mathcal A=2^N$ and $m=|\mathcal A|=2^n$. Vectors $y,w,w^*\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal A}$ include every coalition, with $y_S=g^*(S)$. Put $B=J^\top J$, $D=m\operatorname{diag}(c)$, $A=B+D$ and $\hat M=A^{-1}B$. Row $\hat m_T$ has Euclidean norm equal to the square root of its squared-entry sum. The source loss is $\widetilde L(w)=m^{-1}\sum_{S\in\mathcal A}E[(y_S-(Jw)_S-w^\top\epsilon)^2]$.

Thus $2^n\widetilde L(w)=\|y-Jw\|^2+2^n\sum_Tc_Tw_T^2$ exactly; no large-sample covariance limit is needed.

proof_steps.title: Prove Gram positivity and complete the square
proof_steps.body_md: For the source binary design $J_{ST}=\mathbf1_{T\subseteq S}$, $Jw$ is the subset-sum operator and Möbius inversion proves injectivity. Hence $u^\top J^\top Ju=\|Ju\|^2>0$ for nonzero $u$. The diagonal penalty $2^n\operatorname{diag}(c)$ is positive semidefinite even at $\sigma=0$, so $A=J^\top J+2^n\operatorname{diag}(c)$ is positive definite and invertible. For $u=A^{-1}J^\top y$, completing the square gives $2^n(\widetilde L(w)-\widetilde L(u))=(w-u)^\top A(w-u)>0$ when $w\ne u$, proving unique global minimality.

proof_steps.title: Substitute labels and preserve source domains
proof_steps.body_md: Rowwise labels satisfy $y_S=\sum_{T\subseteq S}w_T^*$, so $y=Jw^*$; F.4 prints the erroneous transpose $J^\top w^*$. Substitution proves the original Theorem 3. The domain issue in Eq.(7) remains separate, without assigning unrequested values to zero weights.

issues.title: 任意 DNN 的全局 Taylor 等式不成立
issues.description_md: 原 Lemma 3 没有解析或收敛前提。
issues.evidence_md: $v(t)=\max(t-1/2,0)$、基线0、输入1，是一层 ReLU 网络；在0邻域恒零，全部 Taylor 系数0，而单变量交互为1/2。
issues.impact_md: 原无条件命题被反驳；有限多项式支持分组是另列的有效子结果。

en.title: The global Taylor equality fails for arbitrary DNNs
en.description_md: Lemma 3 has no analyticity or convergence premise.
en.evidence_md: The one-layer ReLU network $v(t)=\max(t-1/2,0)$ is zero near baseline 0, so every Taylor coefficient vanishes, while the dividend at input 1 is 1/2.
en.impact_md: The unrestricted claim is refuted; finite-polynomial support grouping is a separate valid subresult.

issues.title: 零交互使归一化触发无定义
issues.description_md: 原 Eq.(7) 与 Lemma 2 对所有子集使用除法而未排非空零交互。
issues.evidence_md: 恒定模型 $v=1$ 满足原 DNN 设置，所有非空 $I(T)=K_T=0$；对 $T\subseteq S$ 的触发是通常实数中无定义的0/0，不能约去得到1。
issues.impact_md: 保留原定义域问题，非零域的归一化证明不冒充原无条件命题。

en.title: A zero dividend leaves the normalized trigger undefined
en.description_md: Eq.(7) and Lemma 2 divide by every coefficient without excluding zero nonempty dividends.
en.evidence_md: The allowed constant model $v=1$ has $I(T)=K_T=0$ for every nonempty $T$. Its triggered ratio is the undefined ordinary-real expression 0/0, which cannot be canceled to one.
en.impact_md: Retain the domain issue; the normalization proof on the nonzero domain does not replace the unrestricted claim.

issues.title: Lemma 1 的边缘律不足以给方差和
issues.description_md: 正文只有 Gaussian 边缘，附录才新增 iid。
issues.evidence_md: 一变量两个输出噪声共用 $Z\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)$，$\sigma>0$；全部边缘满足原条件而 $\Delta I_{\{1\}}=Z-Z=0$。PaperDynamics 的反例实际绑定 Gaussian map-law 与原交互。
issues.impact_md: 均值与线性恒等式有效；iid 方差另作为带明确原附录前提的子结果。

en.title: Lemma 1 marginals do not justify summing variances
en.description_md: Only Gaussian marginals occur in the main statement; iid is introduced in the appendix.
en.evidence_md: For one variable, both output noises equal the same $Z\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)$ with $\sigma>0$. Every marginal satisfies the source law, but the dividend noise is zero. The PaperDynamics counterexample binds the Gaussian map-law and actual dividend.
en.impact_md: The mean and linear identity remain valid; the iid variance is a separate subresult with the explicit appendix premise.

issues.title: 触发缩放与 Assumption 1 是不同模型
issues.description_md: Lemma 1 的除以权重会引入逐概念比例；输出噪声也使多个交互相关。
issues.evidence_md: 若 $w_{T_1}=1,w_{T_2}=2$，同一阶数的方差比例为1和1/4；不能使用同一个比例常数。
issues.impact_md: Theorem 3 可在另外明确规定的 Assumption 1 下证明；不宣称该假设由 Lemma 1 推出。

en.title: Trigger scaling and Assumption 1 describe different models
en.description_md: Dividing by weights introduces a concept-dependent scale, and shared output noise correlates dividends.
en.evidence_md: If equal-order weights are 1 and 2, the scaling factors are 1 and 1/4; one common proportionality constant does not apply.
en.impact_md: Theorem 3 is proved under separately imposed Assumption 1, which is not claimed to follow from Lemma 1.

issues.title: Gram 行列式不是对角项乘积
issues.description_md: 原 F.4 把特征值乘积误等同对角项乘积，并把零噪声对角罚项误称正定。
issues.evidence_md: 一变量 zeta Gram 为 $\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$，行列式1而对角积2；$\sigma=0$ 罚项为零。
issues.impact_md: 用 Möbius 单射证明 Gram 正定，再加半正定罚项；原最优命题无需新条件。

en.title: A Gram determinant is not the product of its diagonal entries
en.description_md: F.4 identifies the eigenvalue product with the diagonal product and calls the penalty positive definite even at zero noise.
en.evidence_md: The one-variable zeta Gram is $\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&1\end{pmatrix}$, with determinant 1 and diagonal product 2. At zero noise the penalty is zero.
en.impact_md: Möbius injectivity proves Gram positive definiteness, then a positive-semidefinite penalty is added; the source optimum needs no new condition.

issues.title: 大样本协方差不能替代精确期望
issues.description_md: 原证明把样本数足够大的近似收敛作为固定样本数的等式理由。
issues.evidence_md: 逐行有 $E[\epsilon_T\epsilon_U]=0$（$T\ne U$）和 $E[\epsilon_T^2]=c_T$，求和恰为 $2^n\operatorname{diag}(c)$，无需行间独立或渐近。
issues.impact_md: 逐行精确期望补正同一证明，Lean 直接积分平方残差。

en.title: A sample-covariance limit does not establish the exact expectation
en.description_md: The proof uses large-sample approximate convergence to justify an equality at a fixed sample size.
en.evidence_md: Each row has $E[\epsilon_T\epsilon_U]=0$ for $T\ne U$ and $E[\epsilon_T^2]=c_T$. Summing gives exactly $2^n\operatorname{diag}(c)$, without independence across rows or asymptotics.
en.impact_md: The same proof is repaired by exact rowwise expectations; Lean integrates the squared residual directly.

issues.title: 标签向量转置错误
issues.description_md: 原矩阵行是遮罩、列是概念，所以标签应用 J 而非其转置。
issues.impact_md: 正文 Theorem 3 的末式正确，用正确标签补正证明。

en.title: The label-vector transpose is incorrect
en.description_md: Rows index masks and columns index concepts, so labels use J rather than its transpose.
en.evidence_md: The source rowwise labels are exactly $(Jw^*)_S$. For one variable and $w^*=(1,2)$, $Jw^*=(1,3)$ while $J^\top w^*=(3,2)$.
en.impact_md: The final main-text formula is correct; its proof uses the correct label vector.

issues.title: OR 证明的激活分组边界
issues.description_md: L 与 S 不交时，T 必须仍与 S 相交，不能把空激活项放入内和。另当 L 包含 S 但 L≠N 时，原声称内和零也无效。
issues.evidence_md: $N=\{1,2\},S=\{1\},L=\varnothing$：合法超集T为{1},{1,2}，激活块只取{1}，不是包括空块的二项式和。$L=S=\{1\}\ne N$ 时原内和仅一项1。
issues.impact_md: 全 OR 和减去不激活和给完整同命题证明。

en.title: Activation-grouping boundary in the OR proof
en.description_md: When L is disjoint from S, T must still intersect S; the empty activation cannot be included. If L contains S but differs from N, the printed inner-zero assertion also fails.
en.evidence_md: For $N=\{1,2\},S=\{1\},L=\varnothing$, the admissible supersets are {1} and {1,2}; the activation block is {1}, not the full binomial family including the empty block. If $L=S=\{1\}\ne N$, the printed inner sum has only the term one.
en.impact_md: Subtracting the inactive OR sum from the full OR sum proves the same theorem.

issues.title: Eq.(3) 使用未定义空 AND 项
issues.description_md: 主文 Eq.(2) 只定义非空分量交互，Eq.(3) 却包含空 AND 系数。F.1 规定的是空分量输出，不是主文空交互定义。
issues.evidence_md: 若按通常 Möbius 公式补扩展 $I_a(\varnothing)=a(\varnothing)=b$，取常数网络 $v=1,a=1,o=0$，扩展后的 Eq.(3) 给2而原输出1；该例严格依赖此显式扩展。若约定空 AND 为0，重复消失，但主文 Eq.(2) 未给该约定。Eq.(4) 非空和正确。
issues.impact_md: 记录定义域/约定缺口及条件性反例，不能无说明把辅助扩展当作原定义再宣称原式已否定。

en.title: Eq.(3) uses an unspecified empty AND coefficient
en.description_md: Main Eq.(2) defines only nonempty component dividends, while Eq.(3) includes the empty AND coefficient. F.1 specifies empty component outputs, rather than the missing main-text empty-dividend definition.
en.evidence_md: Under the explicitly stated ordinary Möbius extension $I_a(\varnothing)=a(\varnothing)=b$, the constant network $v=1,a=1,o=0$ makes extended Eq.(3) equal two while the output is one. This witness depends on that extension. An empty-AND convention of zero avoids duplication but is absent from Eq.(2). Eq.(4) uses the correct nonempty sum.
en.impact_md: Record the domain/convention gap and conditional witness; an auxiliary extension is not silently treated as the source definition to refute the source expression.

issues.title: 普通交互与分量交互同名作用域
issues.description_md: Appendix A 七性质以完整模型 v 的普通交互使用该符号，主文 Eq.(2) 以 v_and 分量且只对非空S定义。
issues.evidence_md: 两实例分别是 $I_g$ 与 $I_a$；任意拆分参数不能使 $I_a$ 单独重构完整 $g$，也不能从 $g=g_1+g_2$ 自动推出任意分量间同样关系。
issues.impact_md: 七性质按普通全模型实例保留原前提并证明；符号表明确记录两个局部映射。

en.title: Ordinary and component dividends share a source name
en.description_md: Appendix A uses ordinary dividends of the full model v, while main Eq.(2) applies the name to the v_and component and only nonempty S.
en.evidence_md: The instances are $I_g$ and $I_a$. An arbitrary split does not make $I_a$ alone reconstruct g, nor does $g=g_1+g_2$ imply the same relation among arbitrary components.
en.impact_md: Prove the seven properties with their ordinary full-model instance and source premises; record the two local mappings separately.

issues.title: Appendix E 半模型与裸 v 记号不一致
issues.description_md: 原先明确两个分量等于0.5v，随后 Eq.(14)–(16) 用裸v写变换，未交代是否重新命名分量模型。
issues.evidence_md: 若裸v仍是同一总模型，取一变量 $v(x)=x$、基线0、输入1，原分量 OR 为1/2，Eq.(14) 裸v右端为1。若裸v指固定分量o，则负补集恒等式准确，实际Lean验证此忠实局部解释。
issues.impact_md: 保留原全部式与半模型前提；精确分量补集适配是有效子结果，不无说明宣称原每行缩放一致。

en.title: Appendix E mixes half-model and bare-v notation
en.description_md: The source first sets both components to 0.5v, then uses bare v in Eq.(14)–(16) without specifying a local renaming.
en.evidence_md: If bare v remains the total model, the one-variable model $v(x)=x$ at baseline zero and input one has component OR value 1/2, whereas bare-v Eq.(14) gives one. If v denotes the fixed component o locally, the negative-complement identity is exact; Lean verifies that explicit local interpretation.
en.impact_md: Retain every source equation and half-model premise. Exact component duality is a valid subresult, without claiming that every printed scaling is consistent.

issues.title: Appendix C 的分量标签和噪声拆分符号
issues.description_md: 原第一段把第二个分量也标为 AND，噪声段两个分量都加 gamma。
issues.evidence_md: 取 $v(x_T)=1,\delta_T=0,\gamma_T=1$，两个原噪声分量均为3/2，总和3而目标输出1。
issues.impact_md: 保存原录文与精确反例；不把修改过的优化定义冒充原式。

en.title: Component labels and the noise-split sign in Appendix C
en.description_md: The first paragraph labels both components AND, and the noise paragraph adds gamma in both branches.
en.evidence_md: For $v(x_T)=1,\delta_T=0,\gamma_T=1$, both printed noise components are 3/2 and their sum is three rather than one.
en.impact_md: Preserve the transcription and precise counterexample; an altered optimization definition is not substituted for the printed one.

issues.title: Proposition 1 严格子句失败，一般单调性未决
issues.description_md: 原命题未排零噪声，且原文仅给 Figure 3 数值验证，没有一般解析证明。
issues.evidence_md: $\sigma=0$ 时 $\hat M=I$，全部行范数1；例如一变量 $T=\varnothing,T\prime=\{1\}$ 的比为1而非大于1。Lean 给所有有限总体完整矩阵证明。
issues.impact_md: 仅严格原子句被反驳；同阶不变与真权重独立有效，正噪声一般阶数比及噪声单调子句保留未决，有限数值不替代。

en.title: Proposition 1 strictness fails; general monotonicity remains unresolved
en.description_md: The source does not exclude zero noise and gives only Figure 3 numerical verification, without a general analytic proof.
en.evidence_md: At $\sigma=0$, $\hat M=I$ and all row norms are one. For example, in a one-variable universe, the empty/singleton ratio is one rather than strictly greater. Lean proves the complete matrix boundary for every finite universe.
en.impact_md: Only the unconditional strict clause is refuted. Equal-order invariance and independence from true weights remain valid; general positive-noise order ratios and noise monotonicity remain unresolved, without replacing them by finite numerical checks.

issues.title: 补集恒等式不足以传递稀疏定理前提
issues.description_md: 外引稀疏界有三个游戏条件，分量分解或反向输入尚未核实这些条件。
issues.evidence_md: 精确的有限反演及补集变换只控制重构，不自动给最高阶零、平均单调与多项式界。
issues.impact_md: 外引适配保持范围审查，不冒称原渐近界机器已证。

en.title: Complement duality does not transfer the sparsity premises
en.description_md: The cited sparsity bound has three game-level conditions, not established for split components or reversed inputs.
en.evidence_md: Exact inversion and complement transforms control reconstruction, but do not automatically imply a cutoff, monotone averages or a polynomial bound.
en.impact_md: The external adaptation remains a scope review, without claiming a machine proof of the original asymptotic bound.

issues.title: Eq.(46) 导数漏公共归一化
issues.description_md: Eq.(45)损失有2^{-n}，Eq.(46)导数未带该公共因子。
issues.evidence_md: 真实梯度是原Eq.(46)右端乘 $2^{-n}$。该因子严格正，所以设梯度为0时得到同一正规方程；不改变唯一最优结论。
issues.impact_md: 保留原导数式，重写直接精确期望和完成平方，不依赖该漏因子。

en.title: Eq.(46) omits the common normalization in the derivative
en.description_md: Loss Eq.(45) has the common factor 2^{-n}, which is absent from its derivative in Eq.(46).
en.evidence_md: The actual gradient is the printed right side of Eq.(46) multiplied by $2^{-n}$. This factor is strictly positive, so setting the gradient to zero yields the same normal equations and optimum.
en.impact_md: Retain the printed derivative; exact expectations and completing the square prove the same conclusion without that omission.

issues.title: 原排列构造未说明每步为换位
issues.description_md: Eq.(63)之后用P_i平方为单位，但此前只称每个P_i是permutation matrix，未说明是换位矩阵。
issues.evidence_md: 三循环排列的平方不为单位。可以把所需有限变量排列分解为换位，各因子才满足该性质；也可直接对整体P用 $P^{-1}$ 共轭。实际Lean与重写使用正确的逆和置换。
issues.impact_md: 这是缺少构造说明的证明缺口，Theorem4同阶范数结论未被否定。

en.title: The permutation construction does not specify involutive factors
en.description_md: After Eq.(63), the proof uses P_i squared equal to the identity, although each P_i was described only as a permutation matrix rather than a transposition matrix.
en.evidence_md: A three-cycle does not square to the identity. Decomposing a finite variable permutation into transpositions makes the claim valid for its factors; alternatively conjugate by the inverse $P^{-1}$ of the whole permutation. Lean and the rewritten proof use the correct inverse and permutation.
en.impact_md: This is a missing construction detail in the proof, not a refutation of the equal-order norm conclusion of Theorem 4.
